## Overview

Fieldnote is a quiet log for hobbyist birders. Most entries are made on a phone, standing in a marsh or a wood edge, often with one hand; the tidying happens later on a laptop, scanning a table of the day's sightings. The design has two jobs that pull against each other: feel calm and personal, like a field notebook, and show a lot of rows at once without fuss. The system resolves that by splitting the work: **colour and surfaces carry the warmth, layout and type carry the density.**

The canvas is warm paper (`{colors.canvas}`), not white, and the ink is a soft warm charcoal (`{colors.ink}`), never black. A five-step surface ladder (`{colors.canvas}` → `{colors.surface-1}` → … → `{colors.surface-4}`) carries hierarchy, with hairlines (`{colors.hairline}`) doing the separating that shadows would do elsewhere. That keeps the page quiet: no feed, no gloss, nothing competing with the list.

The single chromatic accent is **forest green** (`{colors.primary}`), the brand's one fixed decision. It is scarce on purpose: the primary action ("Log sighting", "Start your list"), the focus ring, the wordmark, and the lifer marker. A lifer, a species seen for the first time, is the one moment in the product worth celebrating, so it is the only data that earns the accent.

Density comes from compact controls (36px inputs, 8px × 14px buttons), 13px tabular figures in the table, and an 8px row rhythm. On touch screens every control grows to a 44px target; the density is for the laptop, the generosity is for the field.

**Key Characteristics:**
- Warm paper canvas (`{colors.canvas}`) and warm-charcoal ink (`{colors.ink}`); no pure white or black anywhere
- One accent, `{colors.primary}`, reserved for primary action, focus, wordmark and lifers
- Five-step warm surface ladder plus hairlines; shadows only on floating layers
- Inter throughout, tight negative tracking on display sizes, tabular figures for counts and times
- Compact desktop controls that grow to 44px touch targets on mobile
- Soft field tints (sky, sand, clay) for tags and at most one feature band, never for large surfaces
- `{rounded.md}` 8px buttons and inputs, `{rounded.lg}` 12px cards and the table frame

## Colors

### Brand & Accent
- **Forest Green** ({colors.primary}): Primary action, wordmark, focus ring, lifer emphasis. 6.3:1 against `{colors.on-primary}`.
- **Green Hover** ({colors.primary-hover}): Hover state, 15% lighter. Kept above 4.5:1 with white text (5.1:1); a larger step drops below it on a light canvas.
- **Green Pressed** ({colors.primary-pressed}): Pressed state, the same ~18% darkening step as the hover-to-pressed ladder this system was modelled on.
- **Green Deep** ({colors.primary-deep}): Text on `{colors.accent-tint}` (the lifer badge), and accent text on tinted surfaces.
- **Focus** ({colors.primary-focus}): 2px outline with a 2px offset on every focusable element.
- **Accent Tint** ({colors.accent-tint}): Background of the lifer badge and a lifer row's leading marker. Never a section fill.
- **Accent Muted** ({colors.accent-muted}): Decorative only (map pins at rest, illustration strokes). Not for text: it fails 4.5:1.

### Surface
- **Canvas** ({colors.canvas}): Page background, table body, inputs.
- **Surface 1** ({colors.surface-1}): Table header, app nav, feature cards, empty state, row hover.
- **Surface 2** ({colors.surface-2}): Selected row, CTA banner, status badges, disabled button fill.
- **Surface 3** ({colors.surface-3}): Selected filter chip, menus.
- **Surface 4** ({colors.surface-4}): Deepest lift, used for pressed ghost buttons and nested panels. Rare.
- **Hairline** ({colors.hairline}): Row dividers, card borders, nav rules.
- **Hairline Strong** ({colors.hairline-strong}): Secondary-button and chip borders.
- **Hairline Input** ({colors.hairline-input}): Input and select borders. 3.5:1 on canvas, so form fields meet the 3:1 non-text contrast rule.

### Text
- **Ink** ({colors.ink}): Headlines, species names, body.
- **Ink Muted** ({colors.ink-muted}): Nav links, notes column, secondary body.
- **Ink Subtle** ({colors.ink-subtle}): Table headers, captions, footer. 5.5:1 on canvas, safe for small text.
- **Ink Tertiary** ({colors.ink-tertiary}): Placeholders and disabled labels only. 3.4:1, so never for content.
- **Inverse** ({colors.inverse-canvas} / {colors.inverse-ink}): The one dark button, used when green would compete with a nearby primary.

### Field Tints
Soft tints for tags, each paired with its own ink at ≥6.7:1.
- **Sky** ({colors.tint-sky} / {colors.on-tint-sky}): Place tags.
- **Sand** ({colors.tint-sand} / {colors.on-tint-sand}): Plan tier tags, the single tinted feature band on the landing page.
- **Clay** ({colors.tint-clay} / {colors.on-tint-clay}): Reserved for "needs review" (unconfirmed ID, missing place).

### Semantic
- **Success** ({colors.semantic-success}): Sync complete. Bluer and brighter than the brand green, so a status message never reads as a button.
- **Warning** ({colors.semantic-warning}): Offline, sync pending.
- **Error** ({colors.semantic-error}): Validation, failed sync.
- **Overlay** ({colors.semantic-overlay}): Modal scrim at 40% opacity, warm rather than black.

## Typography

### Font Family
- **Inter** (Google Fonts), weights 400 / 500 / 600, for every UI surface. Fallback: `-apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif`. Enable `font-feature-settings: "tnum"` wherever numbers line up in columns.
- **JetBrains Mono** (Google Fonts), weight 400, for timestamps, coordinates and checklist IDs. Fallback: `ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace`.

### Hierarchy

| Token | Size | Weight | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{typography.display-xl}` | 64px | 600 | 1.05 | -2.4px | Landing hero only |
| `{typography.display-lg}` | 48px | 600 | 1.10 | -1.5px | Landing section openers |
| `{typography.display-md}` | 36px | 600 | 1.15 | -0.9px | Pricing heading, mobile hero |
| `{typography.headline}` | 24px | 600 | 1.25 | -0.5px | App page titles ("Sightings"), CTA banner |
| `{typography.card-title}` | 18px | 600 | 1.30 | -0.3px | Feature and pricing card titles, empty-state title |
| `{typography.subhead}` | 18px | 400 | 1.50 | -0.1px | Hero subtitle |
| `{typography.body}` | 16px | 400 | 1.55 | -0.05px | Landing body, form labels on mobile |
| `{typography.body-sm}` | 14px | 400 | 1.45 | 0 | App body, inputs, card body |
| `{typography.body-sm-medium}` | 14px | 500 | 1.45 | 0 | Nav links, chips |
| `{typography.table-cell}` | 13px | 400 | 1.40 | 0 | Sightings table cells (tabular figures) |
| `{typography.caption}` | 12px | 400 | 1.40 | 0 | Badges, table caption, footer |
| `{typography.button}` | 14px | 500 | 1.20 | 0 | Every button label |
| `{typography.eyebrow}` | 12px | 600 | 1.30 | 0.6px | Table headers, section eyebrows (uppercase) |
| `{typography.mono}` | 12px | 400 | 1.40 | 0 | Times, coordinates, checklist IDs |

### Principles
- **Negative tracking scales with size** (about -3.75% at 64px, easing to zero at 14px). It keeps headlines compact without going bold.
- **600 is the ceiling.** Hierarchy comes from size and tracking, not weight; heavy type would break the quiet tone.
- **The scale steps down for the app.** The landing page uses `{typography.display-xl}`; the app tops out at `{typography.headline}`, because the list is the protagonist.
- **Eyebrows track positive** (+0.6px, uppercase) so table headers read as labels, not content.
- **Mono is for machine-shaped values only.** A species name or note is never mono.

## Layout

### Spacing System
- **Base unit**: 4px, 8px primary increment.
- **Tokens**: `{spacing.xxs}` 4px · `{spacing.xs}` 8px · `{spacing.sm}` 12px · `{spacing.md}` 16px · `{spacing.lg}` 24px · `{spacing.xl}` 32px · `{spacing.xxl}` 48px · `{spacing.section}` 96px.
- **App rhythm**: 8px cell padding vertically, 12px horizontally; `{spacing.md}` between the filter bar and the table; `{spacing.lg}` page gutters.
- **Landing rhythm**: `{spacing.section}` between sections on desktop, `{spacing.xxl}` on mobile; `{spacing.lg}` card interiors.

### Grid & Container
- Landing: 1120px max width, centred; feature cards 3-up, pricing 2-up (Free / Flock) at a 720px max width so two tiers don't float in a wide row.
- App: 1280px max width; the table spans the full content width. The filter bar sits in one row above it on desktop.

### Whitespace Philosophy
The landing page breathes; the app does not. Marketing sections get generous `{spacing.section}` gaps so each claim lands on its own. Inside the app, whitespace is spent on readable row height and nothing else; the separation between rows is a hairline, not a gap.

## Elevation & Depth

| Level | Treatment | Use |
|---|---|---|
| 0 (flat) | `{colors.canvas}`, no border | Page, body text |
| 1 (hairline) | `{colors.canvas}` or `{colors.surface-1}`, 1px `{colors.hairline}` | Table frame, cards, nav |
| 2 (lift) | `{colors.surface-2}` | Selected row, CTA banner |
| 3 (float) | `{colors.canvas}`, 1px `{colors.hairline}`, shadow `rgba(38, 36, 32, 0.10) 0px 8px 24px -6px` | Menus, select popovers, the mobile "Log sighting" sheet |
| 4 (modal) | `{colors.canvas}`, shadow `rgba(38, 36, 32, 0.16) 0px 16px 48px -8px` over the overlay scrim | Dialogs |
| Focus | 2px `{colors.primary-focus}` outline, 2px offset | Every focusable element |

Depth on the page itself comes from the surface ladder. Shadows exist only for things that genuinely float above the page, and they are tinted with the ink colour so they stay warm.

## Shapes

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `{rounded.xs}` | 4px | Checkboxes, mobile row markers |
| `{rounded.sm}` | 6px | Place tags, ghost buttons |
| `{rounded.md}` | 8px | Buttons, inputs, selects |
| `{rounded.lg}` | 12px | Table frame, cards, empty state, CTA banner |
| `{rounded.xl}` | 16px | Bottom sheet top corners on mobile |
| `{rounded.pill}` | 9999px | Filter chips, lifer and status badges |
| `{rounded.full}` | 9999px | Avatar, map pin |

Buttons are rectangles with 8px corners, not pills. Pills are kept for things you toggle or read (chips, badges), so the shape itself says "action" or "state".

## Components

### Buttons

**`button-primary`** — The one green action per view ("Log sighting", "Start your list", "Filter").
- Background `{colors.primary}`, text `{colors.on-primary}`, `{typography.button}`, padding 8px 14px, `{rounded.md}`.
- Hover `button-primary-hover` (`{colors.primary-hover}`); pressed `button-primary-pressed` (`{colors.primary-pressed}`); disabled `button-primary-disabled` (`{colors.surface-2}` with `{colors.ink-subtle}`, 5.0:1, so the label stays legible).

**`button-secondary`** — Outlined, for the second action ("Clear filters", "Export").
- Background `{colors.canvas}`, text `{colors.ink}`, 1px `{colors.hairline-strong}` border, otherwise as primary.

**`button-ghost`** — Row actions and toolbar icons. Text `{colors.ink-muted}`, `{rounded.sm}`, padding 6px 10px; hover fills `{colors.surface-2}`.

**`button-inverse`** — Charcoal button for the free tier's "Get started", so it doesn't compete with the featured tier's green.
- Background `{colors.inverse-canvas}`, text `{colors.inverse-ink}`.

### Inputs & Filters

**`text-input`** / **`select`** — 36px tall on desktop (44px on touch), `{typography.body-sm}`, 1px `{colors.hairline-input}` border, `{rounded.md}`.
- Focused (`text-input-focused`): border turns `{colors.primary}`, plus the 2px focus outline.
- Error: border and helper text `{colors.semantic-error}`; the message sits below the field, never only in colour.

**`filter-chip`** / **`filter-chip-selected`** — Toggle filters such as "Lifers only". Selected is a surface lift to `{colors.surface-3}` with ink text, not a green fill, so the accent stays scarce. Backed by a real checkbox or `aria-pressed` button.

### Sightings Table

**`data-table`** — Frame: `{colors.canvas}`, 1px `{colors.hairline}`, `{rounded.lg}`, `{typography.table-cell}` with tabular figures.
- **`table-header`**: `{colors.surface-1}`, `{typography.eyebrow}` uppercase in `{colors.ink-subtle}`, sticky on scroll.
- **`table-row`**: 36px tall, hairline bottom rule. Hover `{colors.surface-1}`, selected `{colors.surface-2}`.
- **Column treatment**: species in `{colors.ink}`; count right-aligned with tabular figures; place as a `place-tag`; when in `{typography.mono}` `{colors.ink-subtle}`; note in `{colors.ink-muted}`, truncated with the full text in a title and in the row's detail view.
- **Caption** ("12 sightings this week") in `{typography.caption}` above the table, left-aligned.

**`sighting-card`** — The table's mobile form: one card per sighting, species and count on the first line, place and time on the second.

**`lifer-badge`** — `{colors.accent-tint}` with `{colors.primary-deep}` text, `{rounded.pill}`. The only accent in the data. It always carries the word "Lifer"; colour is never the only signal.

**`place-tag`** — `{colors.tint-sky}` with `{colors.on-tint-sky}`, `{rounded.sm}`.

**`status-badge`** — Neutral `{colors.surface-2}` pill for "Synced", "Pending", with a 6px semantic-colour dot.

**`empty-state`** — `{colors.surface-1}` panel, `{rounded.lg}`, centred: title in `{typography.card-title}`, one line of help in `{colors.ink-muted}`, and a `button-secondary` "Clear filters".

### Landing Page

**`feature-card`** — `{colors.surface-1}`, hairline border, `{rounded.lg}`, `{spacing.lg}` padding; title `{typography.card-title}`, body `{typography.body-sm}` in `{colors.ink-muted}`.

**`feature-card-tinted`** — `{colors.tint-sand}`, one per page at most (for "Quiet by design"), so the warmth reads as a note, not a pattern.

**`pricing-card`** / **`pricing-card-featured`** — Hairline card; the featured tier (Flock) lifts to `{colors.surface-1}` with a 1px `{colors.primary}` border and the green button. Price in `{typography.display-md}`.

**`cta-banner`** — `{colors.surface-2}`, `{rounded.lg}`, `{spacing.xxl}` padding, `{typography.headline}`.

### Navigation

**`top-nav`** — Landing: 56px, `{colors.canvas}`, hairline bottom rule. Wordmark left in `{colors.primary}`, links in `{colors.ink-muted}`, "Open the app" as `button-primary` on the right.

**`app-nav`** — App: 48px on `{colors.surface-1}`. Current page (`app-nav-current`, `aria-current="page"`) shows `{colors.ink}` text with a 2px ink underline, not green.

**`footer`** — `{colors.canvas}`, hairline top rule, `{typography.caption}` in `{colors.ink-subtle}`.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Keep exactly one `button-primary` per view.
- Use `{colors.primary}` only for the primary action, focus, wordmark and lifers.
- Build hierarchy with the surface ladder first, hairlines second, shadows last.
- Use tabular figures for counts, and `{typography.mono}` for times and coordinates.
- Grow every control to a 44px target on touch, even where desktop is compact.
- Pair every colour signal (lifer, status, error) with text or an icon.

### Don't
- Don't use pure white `#ffffff` for the page or pure black for text.
- Don't fill sections, rows or chips with green.
- Don't add a second accent colour; the field tints are for tags, not emphasis.
- Don't pill-round buttons.
- Don't use weights above 600, or display sizes inside the app.
- Don't put decoration in the app: no illustrations, gradients or photos behind the list.

## Responsive Behavior

### Breakpoints

| Name | Width | Key Changes |
|---|---|---|
| Mobile | < 640px | Default. Table becomes `sighting-card` list; filters collapse behind a "Filter" button into a bottom sheet; hero at `{typography.display-md}`. |
| Tablet | 640 – 1023px | Table returns with Note column hidden; feature cards 2-up. |
| Desktop | ≥ 1024px | Full table, inline filter bar, feature cards 3-up, hero at `{typography.display-xl}`. |

Design mobile-first: the field is the primary context.

### Touch Targets
- Every interactive element is at least 44 × 44px on touch (`pointer: coarse`), including chips, row actions and checkboxes, which grow their hit area rather than their visuals where needed.
- "Log sighting" is a full-width `button-primary` fixed to the bottom of the viewport on mobile, reachable one-handed.

### Collapsing Strategy
- **App nav**: links stay visible (there are three); no hamburger.
- **Filters**: inline row → bottom sheet below 640px, with an active-filter count on the trigger.
- **Table**: card list below 640px; sort controls move into the filter sheet.
- **Pricing**: 2-up → stacked below 640px, featured tier first.

### Image Behavior
- No photography in the app. Bird photos, when added, sit in `{rounded.md}` frames at a fixed 4:3 aspect and never crop the subject's head.

## Iteration Guide

1. Work on one component at a time and name it by its `components:` key.
2. Before adding a section, decide which surface step it lives on.
3. Default app body to `{typography.body-sm}`, landing body to `{typography.body}`.
4. When something needs emphasis, try weight 500, then a surface lift, then `{colors.ink}` over `{colors.ink-muted}`. Reach for green last, and only if it is the primary action.
5. Add new variants as separate `components:` entries rather than modifiers in prose.
6. Check text pairs against 4.5:1 and input borders against 3:1 before adding a colour.
7. Ask for the mobile version of any new screen first.

## Known Gaps

- **Dark mode** is undecided. The surface-ladder structure carries over, but warm dark values and a lighter green for dark surfaces haven't been chosen. Birders logging at dawn may want it.
- **Logo and wordmark** don't exist yet; the wordmark is set in Inter 600 in `{colors.primary}` as a placeholder.
- **Motion** isn't specified. Suggested default: 150ms ease-out for hover and press, 200ms for sheets, and no motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Offline and sync states** have colours and a badge but no full pattern (banner placement, conflict resolution).
- **Map and photo views** aren't designed; `{colors.accent-muted}` is only a placeholder for map pins.
- **Data visualisation** for the life list (counts by year and place) has no chart palette yet.
- **The field tints** were chosen for tags; whether they work as habitat or region categories at scale is untested.
